documents_expected.why: chapter page: what they fund, what they don't, deadlines and what happens if chosen
the application form, which shows what applicants must write and upload

eligibility.rule: Open to individuals, groups and organisations; the chapter aims at individuals and small teams
eligibility.quote: If you are an individual or small team, with an awesome idea that will help the environment, you are encouraged to apply.
alt_quotes: individuals, groups, and organizations alike. If you can fill out the application form, you can apply.

eligibility.rule: Must have or be able to get a PayPal, Wise or Venmo account to receive the funds
eligibility.quote: Applicants must have, or be able to get, a PayPal, Wise, or Venmo account to receive funds if they win a micro grant.

eligibility.rule: The project must have a tipping point of $1,000 or less
eligibility.quote: Projects that have a "tipping point" of $1000 or less where our grant will be the difference between it not happening and making dreams come true.

eligibility.rule: No established projects, salaries, operating, travel, marketing or personal expenses
eligibility.quote: What We Don't Fund: Personal expenses, marketing, salaries, operational expenses, established projects, travel expenses, things having to do with politics or religion.

eligibility.rule: Past winners wait 12 months before applying again
eligibility.quote: If you have won a grant, please wait 12 months before applying again.

documents.item: Online application in English: project description, how the money will be used, about you
documents.quote: Tell us about your awesome project! You have 2000 chars left * How will you use the money? You have 500 chars left * Tell us a little about yourself
Upload up to 5 images that will help the trustees better understand your project.

effort.step: Submit the online application form (next deadline)
If chosen, send payment details within three weeks
effort.quote: Grants will be given to another applicant if a winning applicant does not respond with payment information within three weeks of being chosen.

notes: Grants are $1,000 micro-grants with no strings attached. The chapter only 'hopes' winners send an impact note and photos, so no report duty is recorded. Deadlines repeat every two months; the next one from 2026-11-17 is 27 November 2026.
